name: Materialious
tagline: Watch YouTube-style videos with a clean, private app
description:
Materialious gives you a fresh, modern way to watch YouTube-style videos without being tracked. It connects to privacy-friendly video sources and switches to a backup automatically if one isn't working, so you rarely hit a dead end.

It runs on phones, tablets, and even Android TV, giving you a calm, ad-free way to watch your favorite channels.
